mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vendor (business_name, business_reg_no, ceo_name, phone, email, password, status) VALUES (#{businessName}, #{businessRegNo}, #{ceoName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{password}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT vendor_id, business_name, business_reg_no, ceo_name, phone, email, password, status, created_at, approved_at FROM vendor WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT vendor_id, business_name, business_reg_no, ceo_name, phone, email, password, status, created_at, approved_at FROM vendor ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE vendor SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE vendor SET status = 'REJECTED' WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE vendor SET business_name = #{businessName}, business_reg_no = #{businessRegNo}, ceo_name = #{ceoName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email} WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId}
